milestones.title: Switch on one light
milestones.goal: A single glowing light on the stage.

steps.instruction: Read these four lines. What do you think will appear on the stage? Make a guess, then press **Run**.

check.description: Your program ran and drew on the stage.

hints: Look at the line that starts with `stage.circle`.
`stage.circle(x, y, radius, colour)` draws a circle. x is across, y is down.
`stage.circle(100, 100, 20, "mint")` draws a small mint circle near the top-left corner.
The circle is at x = 320 and y = ___, so it sits in the ___ of the stage.
It draws one butter-yellow glowing circle in the middle of the stage (x = 320, y = 200).
